paragraphs: Clinically AI sells AI software for behavioral health and integrated care workflows. Certified community behavioral health clinics and mental health centers head the list of groups it serves. Addiction treatment providers are also named.

The documentation product generates notes aligned to a provider's own programs, templates and standards of care. A separate module audits charts in real time against the organization's own best practices and regulations. The company says its AI reads the longitudinal client record rather than a single encounter. It presents itself as cloud EHR agnostic, with flexible deployment alongside systems already in use.

On compliance the site states HIPAA compliance, SOC 2 certification and zero data retention. It says it signs business associate agreements. Care delivered in schools is addressed with what the site calls FERPA-aligned support. Supervision tools are listed as coming soon rather than available today. The site claims use by thousands of clinicians nationwide.

quote.text: Chart-Aware AI understands the longitudinal client record.
